title: whole-table aggregation — singleton query-time projection (count/sum/avg/min/max pushed to SQL)

apiCaller.//: The QUERY-TIME projection reads (`GET /api/projections/<snake>`) — same `notLifted` class as the folded projection above, one shape further along: a singleton whole-table aggregation and the grouped read models.  The derivation lists aggregate routes; a projection is not an aggregate, so these credit no derived operation even though they are the whole point of their fixtures.
